premises.text: Enterprise knowledge is siloed in email, IM, and conversations so people repeat work and cannot find who knows what
premises.evidence_span: all the knowledge was siloed. It was siloed in emails, IMs, conversations

premises.text: A Quora-for-enterprise Q&A plus wiki creates an organically growing, searchable company knowledge base organized around questions
Voting and enterprise-context anonymity help endorse answers and surface important 'stupid' questions
premises.evidence_span: We have a voting mechanic that allows people to stand behind and endorse certain answers

premises.text: Corporate-email signup and powerful search find prior answers inside the verified company network
premises.evidence_span: signs up for Opsy using their corporate email address, which we then verify

premises.text: Email and listserv integration lets people ask/answer in Outlook and indexes relevant questions
premises.evidence_span: we allow people to ask questions directly by email, answer them directly by replying to an email

premises.text: Use cases span engineering, sales/CS, and law/consulting to retain intellectual capital
premises.evidence_span: Put it in law firms and consulting firms where you're paying employees a high amount

value.text: Help people at companies share knowledge so the knowledge base is the first place they turn for answers
value.evidence_span: help people at companies share knowledge

causal_links.evidence_span: not being able to know what other people already knew
organically growing, really easily searchable knowledge base for the enterprise
people and companies live in their Outlook email boxes
retain the intellectual capital that they're building over time
